title: Conan lock entry with no recipe revision
description: conan.lock declares a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
limitation: It matches a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix in the parsed conan.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
